Container.Name: Silo-Redis
Container.Overview:
Redis, pre-configured for the Silo media server.
Silo uses Redis for caching and background job coordination. Install and start this container BEFORE installing Silo.
If you already run a Redis or Valkey instance on your server, you can skip this template entirely and simply point Silo's REDIS_URL at your existing instance - just use a dedicated database index to avoid key collisions.
Container.Requires: Install and start this container before installing Silo.

Config.Name: Redis Port
Config.Description: Redis port. Silo connects here via REDIS_URL.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Redis persistence directory. Keep this on a cache pool or SSD.
